caption: The video captures a shirtless boy in dark floral swim trunks standing barefoot on a rectangular black mat laid across a wooden dock over a calm lake. A tree-lined far shore stretches beneath a bright sky behind him. The boy stays planted with his legs and feet still, moving only his arms in a repeated swinging exercise. His hands begin near his chest, drop toward his hips, then sweep outward and upward until the arms extend to the sides. The elbows bend and the hands rise again, climbing past shoulder level toward his head and, on later cycles, fully overhead. As the arms lower they pass in front of the torso with visible motion blur before returning to the hips. This outward-and-upward sequence continues through the excerpt with a slight sway of the torso. The clip ends with the arms raised overhead, the motion still in progress.
